title: Launch a new campaign
summary: Start a campaign from Launch a New Campaign: describe it to the AI assistant by typing or speaking, or write the brief yourself, then review and save it.
bodyMd:
Launch a New Campaign creates the campaign brief, the first step of every campaign. You choose how the brief is written. Describe the campaign to the platform's AI assistant, by typing or speaking, and it writes the brief from your description and your brand guidelines. Or write the brief yourself in the form. Both routes end on the same Campaign Brief tab. Allow about 2 minutes.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account.
  • Target audiences and campaign objectives defined under Company Settings → Campaign Settings — see Define target audiences and campaign objectives.
  • Brand guidelines uploaded under Company Settings → Brand / Logo / Guidelines — see Step 5 — Upload your brand, logos and icons. The AI assistant uses them when writing the brief.
  • A display type and playlist for each touch-point you want to launch on — see Create a display type and playlist.
  • To use the AI assistant: your provider API keys registered under Platform Admin → AI Models / Integrations. You need an OpenAI key for the brief and copy, a Google Gen AI key for images, and a Google Gen AI (Veo 3.1) or LTX (LTX 2.5) key for video. See Connect AI models and providers. Without them the assistant cannot write the brief; write it yourself instead.

Choose how to create the campaign

RouteWhat you doWhat you needWhat comes next
Describe it to the AI assistantType or speak a description; the assistant writes the briefAI integrations with your provider API keysGenerate the storyboard, copy and creative with AI
Write the brief yourselfComplete the Campaign Brief form by handNo AI integrationUpload your own creative for each playlist, or generate it once integrations exist

Describe the campaign to the AI assistant

  1. In the left navigation, select Campaigns.
  2. At the top right, select Launch a New Campaign.
  3. Describe the campaign, by typing or by using the microphone: the brand or product, who it targets, the scene you want to show, and the displays or touch-points to launch on.

    For example: Launch a campaign for Awesome Bags' new weatherproof handbag, targeting upper class females. Show a lady in a high-end restaurant, raining outside, with the handbag on the table. Launch on the Amazon landscape and Amazon portrait displays.

  4. Wait while the AI assistant writes the brief. It draws on your brand guidelines and any industry-specific compliance requirements. The campaign opens on its Campaign Brief tab.
  5. Continue with the steps in Review and save the campaign brief.

Write the campaign brief yourself

Use this route when no AI integration is registered, or when the brief is already written.

  1. In the left navigation, select Campaigns.
  2. At the top right, select Launch a New Campaign.
  3. Choose the option to create the campaign manually instead of describing it. The campaign opens on an empty Campaign Brief tab.
  4. Enter the Campaign Name and Campaign Details.
  5. Continue with the steps in Review and save the campaign brief, completing each field rather than checking it.

Review and save the campaign brief

  1. Check Campaign Name and Campaign Details. Every field is editable.
  2. If the campaign has a landing page, enter it in Campaign Landing Page URL. Select + Add token to insert a platform token into the URL.
  3. Check Promoted Product(s) and Product SKU(s). Press Enter after each value to add more than 1.
  4. Check Target Audience(s) and Campaign Objective. Both lists come from Campaign Settings.
  5. Under ENABLED TOUCH-POINT(S), turn on each touch-point the campaign runs on, then choose where it plays:
    • Digital Signage → Playlist(s)
    • Store Sites → Mobile Site Template(s)
    • Website → Website pages/sections
  6. Select Update Campaign Brief.
A campaign can be enabled on several playlists at once, for example a landscape and a portrait playlist. When its rules match, the campaign plays on every display in the store that carries one of those playlists.

Verify it worked

The campaign shows Status Not Activated at the top right of the page. It appears in the Campaigns list with its enabled touch-points ticked and its playlists listed. It does not play anywhere until you activate it.

Troubleshooting

The AI assistant does not write a brief, or the request fails

Cause. No integration is registered under Platform Admin → AI Models / Integrations, or the API key on the integration assigned to the brief-writing skill is invalid.

Fix. Register the provider and its API key — see Connect AI models and providers — then launch again. To carry on without AI, write the brief yourself.

Next step

  • If the AI assistant wrote the brief: Generate storyboard, copy and creative with AI.
  • If you wrote the brief yourself: Add a campaign to play on a digital signage display.
